q.en: How does Managevent support families alongside a funeral director?

a.en: Funeral directors care for the deceased and statutory funeral rites. Managevent coordinates the gathering itself — sourcing a peaceful Perth venue, arranging wake catering, setting up framed photos and slideshows, and managing guest RSVPs.

q.en: Are digital memorial invitations and tribute books really complimentary?

a.en: Yes. All Memorial Mode digital invitations, attendance tracking and moderated online tribute books are provided free of charge to grieving families.

q.en: How quickly can you arrange a celebration of life or wake in Perth?

a.en: We respond immediately to memorial enquiries and can coordinate venues, refreshments, florals and audio within 48 to 72 hours across metropolitan Perth.
